title: Canonical comparison of degree-zero cohomology fractions and section fractions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L,F$ module sheaves, $s\in\Gamma(X,L)$, and $U$ open. There is an additive equivalence from $Q_0(U)$ [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation] to $Q^\Gamma(U)$ [def-sc-open-section-fraction-presentation] taking $[n,\xi]$ to $[n,c_{U,F\otimes L^{\otimes n}}(\xi)]$, where $c$ is the canonical comparison [lem-sc-open-cohomology-zero-sections]. No invertibility, quasi-coherence or affineness is required.

proof.text: Take DirectSum.map of the additive equivalences c on the numerator groups. DirectSum.map_injective and map_surjective prove bijectivity.

Naturality of c with respect to mulTensorPowSection identifies each relation generator. Surjectivity on each numerator gives the reverse inclusion of generator sets. AddMonoidHom.map_closure then identifies their additive closures.
Apply QuotientAddGroup.congr to the direct-sum equivalence and the relation-subgroup equality. Its formula on quotient representatives and DirectSum.map_of give the generator formula.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09MR, degree-zero and affine-open paragraphs; explicit Lean comparison and quotient argument
